messages:
maria: Thinking out loud — I'd like to run a staged migration of our large app ConfigMaps into a per-model hierarchy. Goal: shrink hot path CM sizes, reduce kube-apiserver load, make per-model feature flag rollouts easier. Plan sketch below.

sam: sounds reasonable, curious how this interacts with Terraform state and kustomize overlays. any proto of the layout?

maria: yes — Terraform will still own the canonical CM content but we'll render one CM per model under namespaced keys `model-<id>-config`. High level steps:
1) add TF resources to create new per-model CMs (dry-run first)
2) modify pods to mount/use `modelConfig` by envFrom or projected volume keyed by annotation `redwood.model/id`
3) gradual traffic split: route 5% -> pods using new CM, validate logs/metrics
4) expand rollout (20, 50, 100) and deprecate the big global CM

oliver: what's the rollback story if a model config causes a perf regression?

maria: rollback options:
- revert TF to re-create old big CM and restart affected deployments
- keep an automated fallback where app reads `MODEL_CONFIG_OVERRIDE` env; platform can set to point to the old CM name (fast path)
- last-resort: k8s label switch to route traffic back to instances not using new CM (we have routing by node pool + pod label)

infra-bot: Reminder: when adding many ConfigMaps Terraform may hit rate limits on the API. Use `parallelism` throttling and `create_before_destroy` cautiously.

anya: also consider using a single ConfigMap per-model but store big blobs in a shared object store (S3) and put only pointers in CM. That reduces etcd footprint.

sam: for kustomize, we can add an overlay that replaces the envFrom with:
```
envFrom:
  - configMapRef:
      name: model-$(MODEL_ID)-config
```
and use a generator or a small pre-process step to render per-model overlays for staging.

maria: will do a small prototype in staging tomorrow. I'll open a RFC and a TF patch. Needs: someone to review TF (sam?), app change CR (oliver?), and CI smoke tests (anya?).

oliver: I can take the CR for the app change. Will add unit test to ensure fallback to old global CM if new key missing.

sam: I'll review the TF and check rate-limit knobs. Can we also add a terraform `null_resource` to run `kubectl apply --prune` in staging for the generated manifests so we test the whole path?

maria: good call. Prototype checklist for tomorrow: TF patch, kustomize overlay generator, app feature flag toggles, smoke test job. I'll post PR links here when ready. :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary rollout job queued for staging at 2026-03-18T02:00Z (id: job-1123).

anya: one more nit — ensure secrets wiring unaffected. If any model configs reference secrets, preserve the existing secret name mapping; don't generate per-model secrets unless necessary.

maria: noted — will keep secrets as-is and use projections. Thanks all.

oliver: +1 :thumbsup:

sam: :shipit: once PRs up, ping me and I'll prioritize review.
